literal: "Of this nature they [are] to us, of this nature we [are]" saying, even if praised, worthless will say friendship.
translation: Even if praised by saying, "They mean this much to us, and we mean this much to them," such friendship will be considered worthless.
modern: இவர் நமக்கு இவ்வளவு நெருக்கமானவர், நாம் இவருக்கு இவ்வளவு நெருக்கமானவர்கள் என்று வார்த்தைகளால் புகழ்ந்து கூறினாலும், அந்த நட்பு சிறப்பற்றது என்றே கருதப்படும்.
explanation: This couplet emphasizes that true friendship transcends verbal expression and boasting. When friends feel the need to constantly measure and praise their bond by saying 'they are this much to us, and we are this much to them,' it reveals an artificiality. Genuine affection is felt deeply and silently; decorating it with words only makes the friendship appear cheap and insignificant.
